preconditions: An attacker supplies an ONNX model whose STFT node's 'signal' input declares tensor(float) with NO shape (shape=None), so schema shape inference cannot reject rank-mismatched runtime tensors
The victim runs the model through onnxruntime's CPU EP with a rank-0 (scalar) or rank-1 (shape {1}) signal tensor

evidence.fixed_version: none at time of writing (0-day; sibling kernels fixed by PR #33517 / 9265e05ae9, STFT/DFT signal ops missed)
evidence.observed_result: Real onnxruntime==1.31.1 (PyPI wheel). A standard-domain STFT model with shapeless inputs: control (rank-2 signal) returns a clean RAN-OK; rank-1 (shape {1}) and scalar (rank-0) signal each abort with SIGABRT (-6) and 'terminate called without an active exception' — STFT::Compute reads signal_shape[NumDimensions()-1] (rank-0 -> signal_shape[SIZE_MAX]) and short_time_fourier_transform reads signal_shape[1] (rank-1) before any rank check, so the rank mismatch walks off the shape span and calls std::terminate(). RESULT: ALL TRIGGER CASES CRASHED, control clean.

real_exploit.target: microsoft/onnxruntime 1.31.1 (real PyPI wheel) — the CPU STFT kernel in core/providers/cpu/signal/dft.cc (STFT::Compute + short_time_fourier_transform), driven via a crafted shapeless-input ONNX model
real_exploit.backend: onnxruntime InferenceSession (CPUExecutionProvider) loading a shapeless-input STFT model and running it with rank-0/rank-1 signal tensors in fresh subprocesses
real_exploit.marker: terminate called without an active exception
real_exploit.demonstrated: control (rank-2 signal) exits clean with 'RAN-OK'; rank-1 {1} and scalar signal each crash the real onnxruntime process with SIGABRT (-6) and 'terminate called without an active exception' (gsl::span contract violation from the unvalidated signal_shape indexing). The process abort is deterministic and confined to the rank mismatch (control does not crash). Impact = denial of service of the inference process (A:H), no confidentiality/integrity impact (the OOB read is a bounds-contract terminate, not a data disclosure).

evidence.notes: No public CVE/GHSA at time of writing. This is the same 'read Shape()[i] before ValidateInputShape/rank check' class as PR #33517 (9265e05ae9, fixed Conv/ConvInteger/QLinearConv/CropAndResize/Einsum/AffineGrid) and the shipped siblings AlignAbort (RoiAlign), OrtOverrun (MaxRoiPool) and AttnOverrun (AttnLSTM). The signal-domain STFT/DFT kernels were not covered by that fix: DFT::Compute (dft.cc:427-428) reads X_shape[NumDimensions()-1] before the axis/rank validation, so a rank-0 DFT input also aborts; STFT is the primary PoC target because it additionally aborts on rank-1 inputs.
